title: The Run-On-Systems Playbook
kicker: A practical guide for owners whose business still runs on them
subtitle: When Nvidia's CEO resigned on 12 Nov 2026, the board said operations would continue without interruption. Most small businesses can't say that about their owner. These four workflows move the daily work out of your head and into systems.

overview.heading: The four workflows at a glance
overview.intro: Each one takes a job that only you do today and turns it into a system your team and an AI agent can run, with you approving what matters.
rows: A customer messages on WhatsApp, Instagram, email or your website.
The reply templates and prices, once.
A quote is sent or a customer goes quiet.
The follow-up wording and timing, once.
The agent drafts a quote, discount or refund.
Each one, before it goes out.

rules.label: What makes it reliable
rules.heading: Three habits that keep it running without you

items.title: Write it down
items.text: Each workflow has a one-page description: trigger, steps, tools, owner.

items.title: One shared record
items.text: Customers, quotes and payments live in one CRM or sheet, not in your phone.

items.title: Clear hand-offs
items.text: The agent knows exactly when to pass a case to you or your team.

workflows.name: Reply to every enquiry
workflows.goal: Every customer gets a fast, useful reply, even when you're busy or away.
workflows.trigger: A new message on WhatsApp Business, Instagram, email or your website form.
steps: Read the message and pick out what the customer wants.
Reply with your approved answers, prices and next step.
Ask one useful question to qualify the lead.
Save the lead in your CRM and notify the right person.
tools: WhatsApp Business, Instagram, email, website form
Google Sheets, Zoho CRM or HubSpot, with ChatGPT or Claude
workflows.approval: replies use only the answers and prices you approved. Anything else comes to you.

workflows.name: Follow up automatically
workflows.goal: No lead or quote is forgotten because you were busy.
workflows.trigger: A quote is sent, or a customer hasn't replied in the days you set.
steps: Track every open quote and lead with a next-step date.
Send a polite follow-up from your approved template.
Stop when the customer replies, and alert the owner of the lead.
Mark lost leads with a reason, so you can learn from them.
workflows.approval: you approve the templates and timing once.

workflows.name: Approvals in one tap
workflows.goal: The agent does the work, and you approve what matters, from anywhere.
workflows.trigger: The agent drafts a quote, discount, refund or anything unusual.
steps: Draft the item with all the details you need to decide.
Send it to you on WhatsApp or email with Approve and Edit options.
Send the approved version to the customer.
Log who approved what, and when.
tools: Google Docs or your quote template
Your CRM or a Google Sheet
workflows.approval: nothing involving money or commitments goes out without you.

workflows.name: Daily summary
workflows.goal: You know what happened today without asking anyone.
workflows.trigger: Every evening at the time you choose.
steps: Collect today's new leads, quotes, payments and open issues.
Write a short summary with what needs your attention.
Send it to you on WhatsApp or email.
Keep a weekly record so you can spot trends.
workflows.approval: read-only: it reports, it doesn't act.
